name: annual-top300-minervini-earnings-regime
primaryStrategyStatement: Korean default: Minervini RS + point-in-time EPS/revenue + KOSPI SMA200 regime only (R1 adopted 2026-07-18; the volatility target was removed as a return drag). Price-only momentum is validation-only.

representativePerformance.status: re-anchored 2026-07-18; provisional pending official strict total return (A2)
representativePerformance.note: The 21.78% CAGR / -16.44% MDD headline is a raw-cache diagnostic inflated by survivorship (price-jump filter drops delisted/crashed names) and in-sample overfitting. It is NOT representative. Use the survivorship-honest, dividend-inclusive bracket below.

honestDiagnostic.priceCache: marcap delisted-inclusive + OpenDART annual dividend reinvestment (split+dividend adjusted; not strict official)

outOfSample.note: the -16% headline MDD is in-sample only; forward MDD is ~-32%

deflatedSharpe.note: does NOT clear the ~50-config multiple-testing hurdle; risk-adjusted edge is not distinguishable from luck. CAGR 90% CI -1.8% to 29.3%.

honestDiagnostic.biasDecomposition: headline 21.78% (raw-cache, vol-on) = honest ~8.8% + ~4pp survivorship + ~9pp data-selection/price-jump filter + ~6pp IS->OOS overfit; dropping the vol target (R1) lifts honest full-sample to 11.80%

recommendedChange.change: Remove the 60-session 18% volatility target; keep the KOSPI SMA200 +/-3% regime filter only.
recommendedChange.evidence: Ablation attributes all drawdown control to the regime filter (+21pp MDD, ~free); the vol target is a pure return drag (~-3pp CAGR, 0 MDD benefit) and its parameters sit at local CAGR minima (overfit). Regime-only doubles OOS CAGR (2.83%->6.14%) and cuts turnover ~72%, in- and out-of-sample.
recommendedChange.implementation: run-annual-top300-minervini-earnings-regime.js now defaults --vol-target 0 (regime-only). Restore pre-R1 behavior with --vol-target 0.18. Verified: regime-only reproduces 11.80%/0.57/-35.98% on the dividend-inclusive cache.

returnSeekingVariant.status: adopted as a calculated BET (2026-07-18), not the conservative default
returnSeekingVariant.config: --eps-weight 1.0 --holdings 15 (pure EPS/revenue improvement tilt, RS momentum dropped) + binary SMA200 regime, vol off
returnSeekingVariant.caveat: Selection does NOT clear the Deflated Sharpe hurdle -- not distinguishable from luck; returns are lumpy (2017/2020/2025 spikes) and config-fragile. The regime overlay protects the downside but the selection alpha may not persist. Adding RS momentum HURTS (dilutes EPS). Aggressive dial: --holdings 10 -> ~14.8% full / 8.7% OOS.

universePolicy.source: year-end KOSPI/KOSDAQ common-share market-cap Top 300 ledger
universePolicy.rankingSnapshot: last trading session of year t
universePolicy.effectiveFrom: first trading session of year t+1
universePolicy.dartMissingTreatment: exclude only the affected signal candidate and record coverage

portfolioPolicy.score: Minervini RS 3/6/12M (40/30/30) percentile 50% + point-in-time EPS/revenue percentile 50%
portfolioPolicy.overlay: KOSPI SMA200 +/-3% regime only (R1 adopted 2026-07-18; volatility target removed, restore with --vol-target 0.18)
portfolioPolicy.costs: buy 25bp; sell 25bp plus 0.18% securities transaction tax
